author.headline: Specialist, Client and Talent Partnership, PTS @ Randstad (Schweiz) AG

repost_content.text:
The Fragile Architecture of the Corporate Ego:

We often speak of the recruitment process as a transaction, a matching of skills to a budget, a resume to a headcount. 

But beneath the surface, it is a delicate dance of human relationships, desires, and ultimately, our deepest vulnerabilities.

Just last week, I witnessed how quickly a beautiful professional connection can shatter, not from a lack of competence, but from the fragile architecture of the ego.

The morning began with pure alignment. A brilliant candidate (male, 50+) emailed my team at Randstad Switzerland, buzzing with excitement after interviewing with our client. He was deeply interested. The chemistry was there.

By the afternoon, the entire bridge was burned to the ground.

What was the "transgression" that caused him to abruptly withdraw in a wave of anger and harsh words? 

The Hiring Manager (female, 50+) had reached out to him directly. No middleman, no corporate shield, just a direct line of communication born out of genuine enthusiasm and a desire to connect.

In our world at Randstad, this directness is a symbol of trust. It is a green flag.

But to him, it was an intolerable breach of "protocol." No matter how much we tried to explain it, he refused to see her outreach as an act of interest. He could only see it as an act of disrespect.

As a recruiter, it was heartbreaking to see a perfect match dissolve. But as an observer of human behavior, it made me wonder: What are we actually protecting when we hide behind "protocol"?

When we demand rigid boundaries in communication, are we seeking professionalism, or are we seeking control?

And I am left with a uncomfortable, yet necessary question that we must dare to ask: 

Would the reaction have been the same if the voice on the other end of that direct phone call had been a man? 

When a woman in leadership takes the initiative to bypass the traditional hierarchy and speak directly, she is often misread. 

Where one sees agility and warmth, an ego conditioned by older, patriarchal structures can perceive a threat to authority. It is a fascinating paradox of the modern workplace: we claim we want authentic, human-centric leadership, yet when a leader steps out from behind the corporate curtain to connect with us, we recoil.

We look so hard for "red flags" in others that we become blind to how our own rigid expectations block our blessings. He didn’t reject the job. He rejected the vulnerability of being approached directly.

In the end, skills can get you the interview. But it is your relationship to your own ego that determines whether you stay in the room.

To my network: Have you ever seen an opportunity fall apart because someone chose "protocol" over human connection? 

Let’s talk about it below.

#LeadershipDevelopment #CorporateCulture #EmotionalIntelligence #RecruitmentRealities #HumanResources #randstad #swissjobs #insuranceindustry

Hinter jeder starken Region stehen engagierte und innovative Menschen:

Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer, Investoren, Fachkräfte und Visionäre prägen gemeinsam das, was wir unter „New Zurich“ verstehen: einen Wirtschaftsraum voller Chancen, Innovation und Zusammenarbeit.

Gebäude, Infrastruktur und Zahlen bilden die Grundlage. Die eigentliche Stärke unserer Region entsteht jedoch durch die Menschen dahinter: durch diejenigen, die sich vernetzen, voneinander lernen und gemeinsam Neues schaffen.

Die grosse Begeisterung für „New Zurich“ und die zahlreichen positiven Rückmeldungen der letzten Wochen freuen mich sehr. Sie zeigen, dass wir als Gemeinschaft viel bewegen können und dass unsere Flughafenregion zu den dynamischsten Wirtschaftsräumen der Schweiz gehört.

Mein herzlicher Dank gilt allen, die bereits Teil unseres starken Netzwerks der FRZ Flughafenregion Zürich - Wirtschaftsnetzwerk & Standortentwicklung sind und allen, die es noch werden möchten (siehe Link in den Kommentaren).

🚀 Inspiration, Markt-Insights und Leistungskultur: Mein Rückblick auf den ImmoSummit 2026! 🚀 

📣 Was für ein intensiver und inspirierender Tag! Der gestrige ImmoSummit 2026 in THE HALL (Dübendorf) hat wieder einmal eindrücklich gezeigt, wie dynamisch sich die Schweizer Bau- und Immobilienwirtschaft entwickelt. Bestens moderiert von Monika Schärer, bot das Programm geballtes Wissen von der Marktanalyse bis zur Wirtschaftsphilosophie.

📈 Nach der offiziellen Eröffnung durch André Ingold und Rahel Kindermann lieferten Michelle Müller und Michael Birrer (Migros Bank / Banque Migros / Banca Migros) eine ermutigende Keynote: „Positive Aussichten in unsicheren Zeiten“. Trotz globaler Dynamiken bleibt der Schweizer Immobilienmarkt robust. Ergänzt wurde dies durch spannende Praxis-Insights im Interview mit Béatrice Schaeppi (Schaeppi Grundstücke AG) sowie den visionären FRZ Strategiereader „New Zurich“ von @Thomas Sevcik und Remo Daguati – ein echter Wegweiser für die Standortentwicklung! 👏 Musikalisch wurde der Nachmittag von Jodok Cello begleitet.

📍 Als Sales Consultant bei der Randstad Switzerland nehme ich extrem viel wertvollen Input für unsere tägliche Arbeit an der Schnittstelle von Projekten und Talenten mit.

An mein Netzwerk: Welcher Impuls vom ImmoSummit hat Sie dieses Jahr am meisten bewegt? Lassen Sie uns in den Kommentaren austauschen! 📝
 
Belina Karaj Jürg DOS SANTOS

As the insurance sector navigates a complex landscape of regulatory shifts and technological disruption, finding specialized talent has become a primary strategic bottleneck. To address this, we have established a Specialized Insurance Recruiting Team designed specifically for the insurance ecosystem.

Unlike generalist agencies, our division operates strictly within the insurance sector. Driven by Jürg DOS SANTOS in sales and Julia O. and Jay Schmid in recruiting, our team leverages decades of industry knowledge to fill highly technical roles.

We focus on three core pillars:

 - Executive Search & Leadership: Securing C-suite and director-level professionals.
 - Technical Operations: Placing vetted Actuaries, Underwriters, and Claims Managers.
 - Risk assessment: Sourcing top-performing Risk Managers and risk specialists.

Our data-driven approach utilizes a proprietary network of high-performing candidates, allowing us to reduce time-to-hire metrics and improve long-term retention.
